parameters.note: Deliberately does NOT include atm_temp_k_level_* or emission_angle_deg. Per-level temperature gaps are handled by pressure-level-coverage accounting at the aggregation stage (configs/aggregation.yaml), not by outright retrieval rejection here — a partially-missing vertical profile is a coverage/quality issue, not grounds to discard the whole retrieval's surface-level data.

rules.threshold_source: dust_optical_depth/surface_temperature_k thresholds: RESEARCHER VERIFICATION REQUIRED — see planning/DECISIONS_REQUIRED.md #13. water_ice_optical_depth threshold: raised from an unverified 0.5 guess to 0.65 on 2026-07-29, grounded in the real dissertation's Fig 3.4.2 descriptive statistics (real iceuncert median / real tauice median ≈ 0.59 — see configs/emirs_simulation_calibration.yaml) — the first real evidence this threshold has had; 0.65 keeps ~0.06 headroom above that real ratio for per-retrieval noise around the median.

rules.threshold_source: RESEARCHER VERIFICATION REQUIRED — no numeric emission-angle threshold is given anywhere in the supplied Chapter 4 text for EMIRS. The SHARP mu >= 0.8 limb-exclusion convention documented elsewhere in the thesis (Table 7.1) applies to the SOLAR domain and must NOT be borrowed here without independent justification against the real EMIRS geometry field.

rules.citation: NOT itemised in the supplied Chapter 4 QC hierarchy text (which lists only 6 rules). Folded in here as a QC-pipeline rejection rule per this task's explicit request. Duplicate detection already exists as a separate, harder validation gate in data_sources/schema.py (validate_schema's check_duplicates_on), which raises on ANY duplicate found in a provider's raw output rather than rejecting individual rows; this rule instead rejects duplicate rows one-by-one (keeping the first occurrence) as part of the accept/reject QC pipeline.
rules.name: duplicate_retrieval
